limitations: The freeze supports production-read release preparation; production-write adapters remain separately gated.

gates.summary: Twelve public surfaces across Graph Core, Program, Runtime, authorization and additive 2.1 modules are machine-inventoried as freeze candidates.
The full npm run release:check suite passes with Runtime, 2.1, migration, compatibility, property, negative and release-readiness checks enabled.
The independent Python checker revision abe2b2d is public, pinned to Mirai security candidate 0243b86, and passes its package job plus Linux, macOS and Windows jobs in public CI run 33622541224.
limitations: The checker consumes an exact Mirai corpus checkout through MIRAI_REPO; the corpus is not duplicated into the checker package.

gates.summary: Federation, Larena-shaped and AI Employee controlled pilots pass deterministically without production effects or canonical writes.
limitations: The Larena and AI Employee artifacts are public-safe controlled pilots, not production acceptance or comparative scientific evidence.

gates.summary: Two isolated AI-assisted executors who did not implement the changes reviewed exact public revision c946d73, reproduced the corrected attack paths and found no unresolved critical or high finding.
limitations: This is an owner-authorized AI-assisted review, not an external human audit, and it cannot authorize production writes.

gates.summary: Legacy Graph and Mirai 2.0 Program compatibility remain covered while Project Capsule migration is dry-run, approval-first and idempotent.

Exact release-candidate revision 8b14c43 passed all 11 public CI jobs, including clean-room installation and Mirai Program checks on Linux, macOS and Windows, plus release-check and readiness-contract validation.
Confirmatory evaluation is explicitly separated from software release readiness and continues to block comparative effectiveness claims.
limitations: No stable release text may claim model independence, superiority or cost advantage as scientifically proven before confirmatory review.
